description: This file contains the definition of the class Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler, which is responsible for compiling Smarty templates into PHP code as part of the Smarty template engine. It includes methods for initialization, compilation process, callback registration, and internal workings to parse and generate compiled templates.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_SmartyTemplateCompiler
classes.description: Class responsible for compiling Smarty templates into PHP code, managing lexer/parser instances, callbacks, and compilation details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the compiler by setting lexer and parser class names and calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: doCompile
methods.description: Executes the compilation of a Smarty template source into PHP code, managing lexer/parser, handling encoding, and post-processing.

methods.name: registerPostCompileCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function to be called after template compilation.

methods.name: unregisterPostCompileCallback
methods.description: Removes a previously registered post-compile callback by key.
